posts.text: Fra Xtrainvestor: https://www.ttnews.com/articles/hexagon-agility-natural-gas?utm_source=chatgpt.com Hexagon Agility showcases longhaul natural gas truck - TT - Transport Topics The Freightliner Cascadia sleeper tractor is outfitted with Hexagon Agility’s back-of-cab and side-mount CNG fuel systems with a combined capacity equivalent to 265 gallons of diesel. Truckingmesse i statene pågår. Ut fra artikkelen leser jeg at Volvo blir nevnt, det mener jeg er nytt. Volvo har ikke hatt X15N i sine trucks før. Sikkert noe nytt som kommer i forbindelse lansering Europa. While the demo truck is a Freightliner model, Hexagon Agility also can install its natural gas fueling systems on other truck brands, including Kenworth, Peterbilt, Mack and Volvo.
